title: Zephyrine and the Garden
author: Dominic Sandoval
blurb: August Galloway, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
